company.description: Avoca AI is a software company that develops an AI-powered communication platform designed for home service industries such as HVAC, plumbing, and electrical services. Its system uses AI agents to handle inbound and outbound interactions, including answering calls, responding to messages, booking appointments, and following up with customers across multiple channels. The platform functions as a front-office solution that automates routine customer service tasks while integrating with existing workflows and customer management systems. It also includes tools for analytics and performance tracking, allowing businesses to monitor call handling, booking rates, and customer interactions in a centralized dashboard. Additionally, the company’s technology supports lead capture, job scheduling, and operational coordination, aiming to ensure that customer inquiries are consistently addressed without reliance on manual processes.
